note: Restored pre–Phase-2 byte-pass throughput defaults (fixed byte budgets). Latency still uses configurable probe counts.

rationale.latency_packet_size: ICMP payload size in bytes (OS ping -l/-s).
rationale.latency_packet_count: Number of probe packets (full=12, quick=4 — same as pre-methodology engine).
rationale.download_pass_bytes: Bytes requested per download pass (full=25 MB, quick=3 MB).
rationale.download_passes: Number of download passes averaged (full=2, quick=1).
rationale.upload_total_bytes: Total upload payload budget (full=20 MB, quick=2 MB).
rationale.download_chunk_bytes: Read chunk size while streaming download (512 KiB).
rationale.upload_chunk_bytes: POST body chunk size while uploading (2 MB).
rationale.timeout: Socket/HTTP timeout for a transfer attempt.
rationale.retry_count: Extra attempts after a failed connection (0 matches original behaviour).
